Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production game animation sprite sheet. Input image 1 is the character identity reference, not a layout. Create an animation atlas of THIS EXACT cream kitten, with the same pink hoodie, orange and white fur markings, round headphones, fluffy curled tail, eyes and soft polished 3D storybook rendering. Actual transparent background.
LAYOUT IS CRITICAL: landscape canvas 2:1 aspect ratio, exact 4 columns by 2 rows of equal square cells. Exactly eight separate FULL BODY instances, one centered within each cell, no overlap, consistent character height 80% of the cell, feet aligned to same baseline at 91% of each cell height. Keep 8% empty padding on all sides, including ears and tail. No grid lines or labels.
Animation frames in reading order: TOP ROW 4 idle frames: 1 relaxed neutral eyes open, 2 gently inhale body raised slightly and tail sways, 3 eyes closed in a cute blink with slight head tilt, 4 relaxed eyes open with tail returned. BOTTOM ROW 4 looping walk-in-place frames: 1 left foot forward right foot back arms opposite, 2 feet passing underneath body, 3 right foot forward left foot back arms opposite, 4 feet passing with opposite arm swing. Front-facing slight three-quarter view maintained in every frame, no change of camera. Clear alternating leg poses and hand motion, not eight duplicates. Same anatomy, proportions, clothing and accessories across all eight frames. Hands empty except existing headphone gesture. No ground shadows, no floor, no text, no objects, no new costume, no checkerboard texture. Crisp alpha edges, high quality cohesive game sprites.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production game animation sprite sheet. Input image 1 is the character identity reference. Create a polished animation atlas of THIS EXACT CHARACTER with all its existing clothing, fur/feathers/scales colors, accessories and proportions preserved. Copy the rendering style and recognizable face of the reference. Actual transparent background with clean alpha, no background painted in.
CRITICAL LAYOUT: landscape 2:1 canvas, exactly FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS of equal square cells, exactly eight separate FULL BODY instances. Each instance centered inside its own cell at identical scale; same baseline for feet at 88% of cell height. Character height 76% of the cell. Leave generous empty 10% padding around ears, feet, wings and tails. Never touch neighboring frames.
TOP ROW four distinct IDLE frames in order: 1 relaxed eyes open, 2 gentle inhale body slightly raised and ears/tail/wing tips subtly lifted, 3 eyes CLOSED in a cute blink and slight head tilt, 4 relaxed eyes open ears/tail settle back.
BOTTOM ROW four distinct WALK-IN-PLACE frames in order: 1 left foot visibly forward, right foot back with opposite arm motion, 2 feet passing under body, 3 right foot visibly forward, left foot back with opposite arm motion, 4 feet passing with opposite arm motion. Clear alternating leg positions and natural arm/wing movement, not repeated identical poses. Keep existing held accessories in the same hands, do not add props. For birds use feet waddling and subtle wing movement.
Keep camera and three-quarter front viewing angle fixed, same coherent anatomy and costume in every cell. No ground plane, no cast ground shadow, no text, no frame borders, no labels, no checkerboard background. High quality coherent game character assets, sharp readable silhouette, soft storybook 3D shading. Image 1 is a visual identity reference, not a sheet layout.
